claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a generic white/black game console with a black stripe and a black controller, but brand/model text is not readable; PS5 slim cannot be confirmed.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal/serial/repair indicators shown; photos do not confirm whether it was opened or repaired.
No temperature/usage test or gameplay/benchmark footage shown.
Ports/slots are visible, but no test showing each port working is shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Only one controller is clearly shown; no receipt or proof of included items is shown.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch (photos don’t confirm PS5 slim); pricing could be wrong if it’s a different console.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (or the console’s system info screen) showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly lower-spec console with one controller, worst-case for compatibility and resale.

risks.risk: Doesn’t power on properly or has hidden faults (disc drive/HDMI/power issues).
risks.proof: Short video clip of the console powering on to the home screen, plus a quick HDMI display confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty (worst-case) until a working boot is shown.

risks.risk: Ports may not work (HDMI, USB, power, network).
risks.proof: Video showing at least HDMI output working and one USB device/controller connection working (controller recognized).
risks.if_unproven: Price as ports unverified; assume possible port faults and reduce accordingly.

risks.risk: Controller issues (drift, unresponsive buttons, charging problems).
risks.proof: Clip showing controller connected and responding in a simple on-screen test (moving sticks + pressing buttons), ideally with battery/charging indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller condition unknown; assume possible drift/button issues.

risks.risk: Overheating or thermal problems (seller claim not testable from photos).
risks.proof: Video of a short gameplay/session or stress test with no shutdowns (even 10–15 minutes) and stable performance.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential thermal risk (worst-case) until a run test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/cables (seller says original pads and receipt; photos don’t show cables/HDMI/power adapter).
risks.proof: Photo/clip laying out everything included: power cable, HDMI cable, controller(s) count, and any receipt/box/manual if claimed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst-case missing cables/accessories).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (or system info screen) to confirm exact brand and model.
Video of the console booting to the home screen with HDMI working.
Video showing controller connection and responsiveness (sticks + face buttons) and battery/charging status if applicable.
Photo/clip of all included accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller count, and any receipt/box/manual).
Short run clip (10–15 minutes) showing no overheating/shutdowns.
response.reason: The witness confirms a game console and a controller, but the exact brand/model and working condition (power/ports/controller responsiveness) are not verifiable from the photos. Without at least model confirmation and a working test, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
